nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## About this workflow

This template runs the **Image to Video** task (`MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo` node), which covers both:

- **t2va** (text-to-video), when no images are connected
- **fl2va** (first/last-frame image-to-video), when `first_frame` and/or `last_frame` are connected

**Key inputs**

- **first_frame / last_frame**: optional keyframes; the model generates the motion between them
- **prompt**: describe the shots, motion, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

# MiniMax H3 Prompt Template

Running the base model in ComfyUI means the H3-Context-IR preprocessor isn't there. You write the structure yourself.

---

## Blank Template

```
[SCENE] <Location. Subject. What is happening. One or two sentences, present tense.>

[Shot 1] <Shot size and angle>, <subject action>. Camera: <motion type>, <speed/amplitude if it matters>.

[Shot 2] At <00:0X.XXX>, <cut description>. <Subject action>. Camera: <motion type>.

[Shot 3] At <00:0X.XXX>, <cut description>. <Subject action>. Camera: <motion type>.

[DIALOGUE]
(S1) "<exact line>" — <delivery: flat, shouted, whispered>
(S2) "<exact line>" — <delivery>

[SFX] <Physical sounds tied to visible events, in playback order.>

[AMBIENCE] <Constant environmental bed.>

[MUSIC] <Instrumentation, structure over time, where hits land.>

[NEGATIVE] <What must not appear or happen.>
```

---

## Rules That Change Output

**Timestamps mark cuts only.** Never use a timestamp to describe continuous action inside a shot — use prose: "halfway through the shot," "after a brief pause."

**Camera: motion type first.** Push in, pull back, pan left, tilt up, track right, orbit, whip. Add speed or amplitude only when it defines the result.

**Every clause must be visible or audible.** Abstractions get ignored or invented around. "A sense of dread" is nothing; "her hand stops halfway to the door" is something.

**Dialogue budget: ~2.5 words/second.** A 12s clip fits 25–30 spoken words *if nothing else needs to happen*. Overload it and H3 rushes or truncates delivery.

**One speaker per shot.** The single most reliable trick for clean lip sync. Two people talking means cutting between them.

**Speaker IDs assigned in order of first occurrence** and kept attached to the same voice throughout.

**Four sound jobs stay separate:** dialogue, physical SFX, ambience, music. Collapsing them produces generic cinematic mush.

**Negative direction is unusually effective** on this model. Worth being specific.

---

## Reference Mode (R2V)

Uses `ref2va` weights, not `fl2va`.

Tag inputs in connection order, number each category independently:

```
<Picture 1> — identity: face, hair, build
<Picture 2> — wardrobe only
<Video 1>   — camera language and cutting rhythm
<Audio 1>   — voice timbre and delivery
```

Give every reference exactly one job, stated explicitly. Limits: 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio clips. Audio cannot be sent alone — it must accompany at least one image or video.

---

## Grid Constraints

- Native canvas: 768px short edge, capped at 768×1344, rounded to a multiple of 32
- Duration snaps to 17k+5 frames at 24fps (e.g. five blocks = 90 frames)
- Prompt budget: 7,000 characters — enough to storyboard inside the prompt

---

## Worked Example — 12s I2VA

```
[SCENE] A scorched battlefield under a dark sky. An armored winged
figure stands over fallen enemies, sword lowered, violet fire running
along the blade.

[Shot 1] Medium-wide, low angle. She lifts her head and raises the
sword until it stands vertical before her. Camera: push in, slow.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, cut to a tighter medium as a demon lunges in
from screen left. She catches the strike on the flat of the blade.
Camera: track right with the impact.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.500, cut to a low angle behind her. She sidesteps
the charge, then brings the sword down two-handed into its shoulder.
It drops to one knee. Camera: whip to follow the blade, then settle.

[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, cut to medium-wide. She drives the blade
through its chest. The body slumps and goes still. Camera: pull back,
slow, and hold.

[SFX] Ring of steel drawn upright. Low roar. Claws scraping plate.
Heavy clang of the parry. Boots grinding on scorched rock. Wet impact
of the cut. Guttural bellow. Crunch of the overhead strike. Choked
snarl cut short. Blade sliding free. Body hitting ground.

[AMBIENCE] Constant low crackle of flame. Distant fire across the
field. Faint wind.

[MUSIC] Epic orchestral battle score. Low brass and war drums enter
at 00:02 on the lunge. Strings build through the exchange. Full
choral hit at 00:09 on the killing thrust. Thins to a single
sustained low string as the body falls still.

[NEGATIVE] No dialogue. No slow motion. No lens flare. No cuts other
than those listed. No additional enemies entering frame.
```

---

## Sources

- `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/docs/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_base_en.md` — T2VA, I2VA, FL2VA, L2VA
- `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3/blob/main/docs/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_ref_en.md` — R2V

Full Prompt
widgets_values:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] 
**[Subject]**
A young adult demonic cyborg woman with warm bronzed tan skin, long voluminous wavy fiery red hair flowing past her waist and blowing behind her, a pair of large glossy dark maroon-black ridged horns curving upward and inward from her head, glowing violet eyes, a glowing violet gem embedded in the center of her forehead like a third eye, full deep red lips

**[Cybernetics]**
Polished copper-bronze metallic armor plating over both shoulders, a black and chrome mechanical collar around her neck with a glowing violet core at the base of her throat, black mechanical struts running down from her chest along the sides of her bare midriff to her hips, fully robotic black and chrome forearms and hands with segmented skeletal fingers, small glowing violet lights studded along both arms, copper-bronze armored mechanical knee plates with exposed joint hardware

**[Outfit]**
White cropped tank top splattered and stained with blood-red smears, bare midriff, a brown leather belt with a round brass buckle, a brown leather strap running down one thigh, baggy light-wash ripped denim jeans with large tears at the thighs and knees, red leather lace-up combat boots

**[Prop]**
A dark burgundy leather duffel bag with metal chain and ring details, held by its straps in one robotic hand

**[Expression]**
Calm, serious, gaze lowered toward the tracks ahead

**[Pose]**
Walking forward mid-stride along the railroad tracks, one arm carrying the duffel bag at her side, the other arm swinging loosely 


**[Style]**
Cinematic, photorealistic, smooth continuous motion, consistent character throughout, seamless morphing scene transitions, moody atmospheric lighting, drifting glowing particles

**[Subject Motion]**
She walks steadily forward along the center of the railroad tracks toward the viewer at a slow, confident pace, the duffel bag swinging gently in one hand, her free hand swaying at her side. As she walks, she turns her head slowly to look around at her surroundings, glancing left, then right, then up, taking in each new place with quiet curiosity. Her hair and clothing move naturally with each step and with the breeze

**[0–5 seconds]**
Misty dark forest of towering pine trees, ferns and wet boulders lining the tracks, glowing orange embers and white sparkles drifting in the air. She walks forward and glances to her left at the giant tree trunks

**[5–10 seconds]**
The forest seamlessly dissolves and morphs around her into a vast golden wheat field at sunset, the tracks continuing straight ahead to the horizon, warm golden light, wheat swaying in the wind. She keeps walking without breaking stride, turns her head to the right, and looks out across the field

**[10–15 seconds]**
The wheat field morphs into a snowy mountain pass at blue hour, the tracks winding between snow-covered rocks and pine trees, light snow falling. She continues walking forward, tilts her head up to watch the snowflakes falling, then lowers her gaze back toward the tracks ahead

**[Camera]**
Slow steady tracking shot moving backward in front of her, keeping her centered as she walks
